label: Bible Study
prompt: I was _____ when they said unto me, Let us go into the house of the LORD.
verse: I was glad when they said unto me, Let us go into the house of the LORD.
note: A pilgrim's Song of Degrees — sung on the road up to Jerusalem's temple.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God, even our Father, which hath loved us, and hath given us everlasting consolation and good _____ through grace,
verse: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God, even our Father, which hath loved us, and hath given us everlasting consolation and good hope through grace,
note: Everlasting consolation and good hope, given through grace — Paul's gift list for an anxious church.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And one went out into the field to gather herbs, and found a wild vine, and gathered thereof wild _____ his lap full, and came and shred them into the pot of pottage: for they knew them not.
verse: And one went out into the field to gather herbs, and found a wild vine, and gathered thereof wild gourds his lap full, and came and shred them into the pot of pottage: for they knew them not.
note: A well-meaning cook shredded wild gourds into the prophets' stew — and the next verse finds out why that was a mistake.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And Enoch _____ with God: and he was not; for God took him.
verse: And Enoch walked with God: and he was not; for God took him.
note: Enoch never died — just walked with God until one day he walked right on home.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Doth not behave itself _____, seeketh not her own, is not easily provoked, thinketh no evil;
verse: Doth not behave itself unseemly, seeketh not her own, is not easily provoked, thinketh no evil;
note: Love's etiquette: it 'doth not behave itself unseemly' — no rudeness — and it is not easily provoked.
